intent:
Implement GitHub issue #1317: a web run's meta keeps the generic https://claude.ai/code link instead of the session's real URL.

Background: when a run is handed to a Claude Code cloud session, the CloudDriver (packages/the-framework/src/driver/cloud.ts) learns the real session URL and emits it in an 'action' event (label "cloud <url>") and in the result text, but the run's meta.sessionLink stays the generic CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_LINK ("https://claude.ai/code") recorded by the initial 'session' event. The run view links through the action event so the UI mostly works, but any surface reading meta.sessionLink dead-ends at the generic page for exactly the runs where a deep link exists.

The fix: when the cloud hand-off resolves, get the real URL folded into the run meta. The store already folds sessionLink from 'session-update' events (packages/the-framework/src/store/run-store.ts, the session-update case) - find where the framework emits session-update (search src/cli.ts) and make the cloud hand-off path carry the real session URL through it, or emit the session-update alongside the existing action event. Keep the change small and follow the existing event contract; do not invent new event kinds.

Add or extend tests pinning that a cloud run's meta ends with the real session URL as sessionLink. Run the package test suite (cd packages/the-framework && pnpm test) and make it pass (note: 10 daemon.test.ts failures are pre-existing in this container - verify they fail identically on the base commit before dismissing them). Add a changeset in .changeset/ marking '@gemstack/the-framework' as a patch. Open a draft pull request whose description starts with "Closes #1317".
